name: eca-operations-agent
description: Ecommerce Academy Operations Coworker — the daily running of the store. A morning brief that reads Shopify, Meta Ads and your inbox and tells you what needs doing today, a customer service skill that drafts your replies and learns which ones it can handle alone, a landing page builder that installs into your theme, and a skill builder that turns any repeatable task of yours into a reusable skill.  What's new (v1.14.0): Add survey skills, morning brief and customer service, and fix skill labels that were too long to load
